newBssid.text: A previously observed network name is advertising an unfamiliar access-point identity.

weakerSecurity.text: A previously observed network name is advertising weaker wireless security.

openKnownName.text: A network name previously observed with WPA2/WPA3 is now also advertised open.

signalDifference.text: Access points using the same name have widely different signal strengths; this can be normal.

channelChanged.text: A network name is advertised on a channel outside its initial session observations; roaming can explain this.

gatewayMacChanged.text: The cached gateway MAC differs from the initial observation for this network/interface.

dnsChanged.text: Configured DNS servers differ from the initial network observation.

duplicateMac.text: Multiple cached neighbor IPs use one MAC; bridges and proxy ARP can explain this.

hostsChanged.text: The hosts file hash changed since the initial observation.

proxyChanged.text: Proxy configuration changed since the initial observation.

portalCredentials.text: An opted-in browser page has a password field while Windows reports limited connectivity. It may be a login page, not necessarily a captive portal.

portalPayment.text: An opted-in browser page has a card-number field while connectivity is limited. Verify any access-payment request independently.

limitedPortal.text: Windows reports limited connectivity alongside sensitive form fields. A network outage or ordinary login page can also explain this.
